metaDescription: Learn about MyTranscript, the free AI-powered YouTube transcript extractor and video summarizer.

## About MyTranscript

MyTranscript is a free, AI-powered web application that extracts timestamped transcripts from any YouTube video and generates instant AI summaries, key takeaways, and chapter breakdowns.
